name: Panadería Luna
about: A family bakery making fresh bread, pastries and cakes every morning since 1998.

faqs.q: Do you take card? | can I pay by card | payment methods | contactless
faqs.a: Yes, we take cards and contactless payments, and cash too.

faqs.q: Do you have gluten free bread? | gluten free | celiac | coeliac
faqs.a: We bake a gluten-free loaf on Tuesdays and Fridays. It's made in a shared kitchen, so it isn't safe for severe allergies.

faqs.q: Can I order a cake? | custom cake | order a birthday cake
faqs.a: Yes! Call us or come in at least 2 days before. Cakes start at 25 €.

faqs.q: Do you deliver? | delivery | home delivery
faqs.a: We don't deliver, but you can call ahead and we'll have your order ready to pick up.
